name: termux_find
params: dir:string:起始目录|name:string:文件名关键字
cmd: sh /data/adb/lemon_kernel/lemon/dedup/run.sh termux_find export PREFIX=/data/data/com.termux/files/usr; export PATH=$PREFIX/bin:/system/bin; d=$dir; if [ -z "$d" ]; then d=$PREFIX; fi; find "$d" -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -i $name | head -n 100
